verdict.rationale: AvaTax's CreateTransaction and GetTransactions APIs record and retrieve individual transaction details (address, tax amount, presumably jurisdiction) and nexus/tax-code data can be queried, suggesting some reconstructability, but there is no explicit documentation of a consolidated audit trail showing the exact rate, rule, and product-category reasoning per transaction, nor an export mechanism for audit purposes. Missing for 10: explicit audit-log/export feature documentation, evidence of rule/rate versioning retained per transaction, and independent confirmation of audit usability.
